        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify聊天响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyChatResponse(\n    response: DifyChatResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; userMessage: ChatMessageRecord; assistantMessage: ChatMessageRecord }&gt; {\n    // 1. 创建或更新对话会话\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      app_type: appType,\n      session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\n      status: 'active'\n    });\n\n    // 2. 保存用户消息\n    const userMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: &#96;user_${response.id}_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'user',\n      content: userQuery,\n      query: userQuery,\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined,\n      app_type: appType,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    // 3. 保存AI助手消息\n    const assistantMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: response.id,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'assistant',\n      content: response.answer,\n      app_type: appType,\n      dify_event: response.event,\n      dify_mode: response.mode,\n      dify_answer: response.answer,\n      prompt_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.prompt_tokens,\n      completion_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.completion_tokens,\n      total_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.total_tokens,\n      total_price: response.metadata?.usage?.total_price,\n      currency: response.metadata?.usage?.currency,\n      latency: response.metadata?.usage?.latency,\n      retriever_resources: response.metadata?.retriever_resources ? JSON.stringify(response.metadata.retriever_resources) : undefined,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    return { conversation, userMessage, assistantMessage };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify工作流响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\n    response: DifyWorkflowResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any,\n    existingConversationId?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; workflowExecution: WorkflowExecutionRecord }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 自动保存对话摘要（使用指定的消息列表）\n  const autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async (messages: Array&lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&gt;) =&gt; {\n    if (!projectId) return;\n    \n    // 检查是否有至少一轮完整的问答（至少一条用户消息和一条AI消息）\n    const userMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'user');\n    const aiResponseMessages = messages.filter(msg =&gt; msg.sender === 'ai');\n    \n    // 如果没有完整的对话，不保存\n    if (userMessages.length === 0 || aiResponseMessages.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // 如果有已保存的对话来源ID，先尝试删除旧的（如果存在）\n    // 然后保存新的对话摘要\n    try {\n      // 如果已经有保存的对话，更新它；否则创建新的\n      if (savedConversationSourceId) {\n        // 尝试删除旧的来源记录（使用数据库ID）\n        try {\n          const idNumber = parseInt(savedConversationSourceId);\n          if (!isNaN(idNumber)) {\n            await api.delete(&#96;/source-information/${idNumber}&#96;);\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          console.warn('删除旧对话记录失败:', error);\n          // 如果删除失败，继续创建新的\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 保存新的对话摘要，使用 project-${projectId} 作为 pageType，传入消息列表\n      const savedId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(undefined, messages);\n      \n      if (savedId) {\n        setSavedConversationSourceId(savedId);\n        \n        // 刷新历史记录\n        await loadSources(); // 重新加载来源列表\n        // 更新历史记录列表，但不自动切换视图（避免强制跳回历史记录页面）\n        await checkHistoryRecords(false); // 传入 false 表示不自动切换视图\n        \n        console.log('[ProjectResources] 对话摘要已自动保存:', savedId);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[ProjectResources] 自动保存对话摘要失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

'...' : ''),\n        status: 'active'\n      });\n\n      // 保存用户消息\n      const userMessageId = &#96;user_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\n        message_id: userMessageId,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        message_type: 'user',\n        content: userQuery,\n        query: userQuery,\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\n        status: 'completed'\n      });\n\n      // 保存助手回复\n      const assistantMessageId = &#96;assistant_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\n        message_id: assistantMessageId,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        message_type: 'assistant',\n        content: response.content,\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\n        prompt_tokens: response.usage.promptTokens,\n        completion_tokens: response.usage.completionTokens,\n        total_tokens: response.usage.totalTokens,\n        status: 'completed'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('保存消息历史失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响主流程\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成对话ID\n   */\n  private generateConversationId(): string {\n    return &#96;conv-${Date.now()}-${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const DialogueContent: React.FC&lt;DialogueContentProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 自动滚动到底部\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: \"smooth\" });\n  }, [messages]);\n\n  const handleSend = async (override?: { content: string; files: File[] }) =&gt; {\n    const draftContent = override?.content ?? query.trim();\n    const draftFiles = override?.files ?? selectedFiles;\n\n    if (!draftContent &amp;&amp; draftFiles.length === 0) return;\n\n    let activeConversation = conversation;\n\n    if (!activeConversation &amp;&amp; onEnsureConversation) {\n      try {\n        setIsLoading(true);\n        setErrorMessage(null);\n        setErrorDetail(null);\n        const ensured = await onEnsureConversation();\n        if (!ensured) {\n          setIsLoading(false);\n          setErrorMessage(\"请先在左侧选择来源并创建对话\");\n          return;\n        }\n        activeConversation = ensured;\n        setMessages(ensured.messages || []);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        console.error(\"创建对话失败:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        setErrorMessage(error?.message || \"创建对话失败，请稍后重试\");\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!activeConversation) {\n      setErrorMessage(\"请先创建对话\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setErrorDetail(null);\n\n    try {\n      const submission = {\n        content: draftContent || \"已上传文件\"\n,\n      };\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class TriggerAgentUseCase {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 构建对话数据，包含根据contextWindowSize截取的上下文历史\n   * 此方法适用于所有工具（五看、三定、技术矩阵、传播、展具与视频、翻译等）\n   * @param conversation 对话对象\n   * @param conversationQuery 对话查询内容\n   * @param targetSources 目标来源\n   * @param dto 触发Agent的DTO，包含contextWindowSize参数\n   * @returns 包含历史上下文的对话数据\n   */\n  private buildConversationData(\n    conversation: any,\n    conversationQuery: string,\n    targetSources: any[],\n    dto: TriggerAgentDTO\n  ) {\n    const sortedMessages = [...(conversation.messages || [])];\n    // 根据contextWindowSize构建上下文（最近N条消息或全部历史）\n    // contextWindowSize: 5/10/20 表示最近N条消息，0 表示全部历史\n    const context = buildConversationContext(sortedMessages, {\n      historyLimit: dto.contextWindowSize,\n    });\n\n    // 获取最后一条助手消息和用户消息，用于字段映射\n    const lastAssistantMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'assistant');\n    const lastUserMessage = [...sortedMessages].reverse().find((m) =&gt; m.role === 'user');\n\n    return {\n      query: conversationQuery,\n      sources: targetSources,\n      files: [],\n      history: context.history, // 根据contextWindowSize截取的历史消息\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      // 子Agent（如五看、三定等）每次调用都是独立的分析任务\n      // 不需要传递 conversationId，让 Dify 创建新的对话\n      conversationId: '',\n      featureType: dto.featureType,\n      lastAssistantMessage: lastAssistantMessage || undefined,\n      lastUserMessage: lastUserMessage || undefined,\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 聊天消息相关数据库表结构\n-- 用于存储AI对话和Dify返回消息\n\n-- 1. 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE",

        "contents": "export class FileService {\nprivate generateFileId(): string {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建文件记录\n   */\n  async createFile(params: CreateFileParams): Promise&lt;FileRecord&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 计算文件哈希值\n      let fileHash: string | undefined;\n      if (fs.existsSync(params.file_path)) {\n        fileHash = await this.calculateFileHash(params.file_path);\n        \n        // 检查是否已存在相同哈希的文件\n        const existing = await this.findByHash(fileHash);\n        if (existing) {\n          // 如果文件已存在，增加使用次数并返回现有记录\n          await this.incrementUsageCount(existing.file_id);\n          return existing;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const fileId = this.generateFileId();\n      const tagsJson = params.tags ?         "contents": "const DialogueContent: React.FC&lt;DialogueContentProps&gt; = ({\n  conversation,\n  sources,\n  sentSourceIds = [],\n  onSourcesSent,\n  contextWindowSize,\n  onContextWindowSizeChange,\n  workflowId,\n  hasMoreMessages,\n  onLoadMoreMessages,\n  isLoadingMore,\n  onMessageSent,\n  onSaveToNotes,\n  onEnsureConversation,\n  onCreateNewConversation,\n  availableWorkflows = [],\n  selectedWorkflowId,\n  onWorkflowChange,\n  isWorkflowLoading = false,\n  dialogueTitle = \"AI内容助手\",\n  pageType,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [query, setQuery] = useState(\"\");\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState&lt;Message[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [selectedFiles, setSelectedFiles] = useState&lt;File[]&gt;([]);\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [errorDetail, setErrorDetail] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const messagesEndRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;(null);\n  const lastSubmissionRef = useRef&lt;{ content: string; files: File[] } | null&gt;(null);\n\n  // 同步对话消息\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (conversation) {\n      const rawMessages = conversation.messages || [];\n      // 按消息ID去重，保留最新的消息\n      const messageMap = new Map&lt;string, Message&gt;();\n      rawMessages.forEach((msg) =&gt; {\n        messageMap.set(msg.id, msg);\n      });\n      // 按时间排序\n      const uniqueMessages = Array.from(messageMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n        const timeA = a.createdAt instanceof Date ? a.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();\n        const timeB = b.createdAt instanceof Date ? b.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();\n        return timeA - timeB; // 升序排列，最早的在前\n      });\n      setMessages(uniqueMessages);\n    } else {\n      setMessages([]);\n    }\n    setErrorMessage(null);\n    setErrorDetail(null);\n  }, [conversation]);\n\n  // 自动滚动到底部\n  useEffect(\n\n;",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n          input: workflowInput,\n        });\n\n        // 从工作流执行结果中提取 Dify conversation_id\n        // Agent 节点的输出中可能包含 conversation_id\n        let newDifyConversationId: string | null = null;\n        \n        // 尝试从工作流执行结果的数据中提取 conversation_id\n        // 首先检查 outputs 中是否包含 conversation_id\n        if (workflowResult?.data?.outputs) {\n          const outputs = workflowResult.data.outputs;\n          if (outputs.conversation_id &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.conversation_id === 'string') {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.output &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.output === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.output.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.output.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.metadata &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.metadata === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.metadata.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.metadata.conversation_id;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果还没有找到，尝试从 extractedOutput 中提取\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": ");\n\n-- 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 知识使用日志表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_usage_logs (\n    ",

        "contents": "export const buildConversationContext = (\n  messages: ConversationMessage[] = [],\n  options?: ConversationContextOptions\n): ConversationContextResult =&gt; {\n  const historyLimit = options?.historyLimit ??         "contents": "/**\n * AI问答服务\n */\nexport class AiSearchService {\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 创建AI问答对话表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_conversations (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT NOT NULL,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )\n      &#96;);\n      \n      // 如果表已存在但没有 page_type 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN page_type TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 page_type 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 如果表已存在但没有 dify_conversation_id 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN dify_conversation_id TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 dify_conversation_id 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 创建AI问答消息表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_messages (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')),\n          content TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT,\n          outputs TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_search_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n        )\n      &#96;);\n\n      // 创建输出内容表\n      await\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const StudioSidebar: React.FC&lt;StudioSidebarProps&gt; = ({\n  outputs = [],\n  conversations = [],\n  onShowConversationList,\n  onTriggerFeature,\n  executingFeatureId,\n  statusMessage,\n  onShowFieldMappingConfig,\n  studioTitle = \"更多工具箱\",\n  featureLabelMap = {},\n  enabledToolIds,\n  pageType,\n  onDeleteConversation,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [selectedConversation, setSelectedConversation] = useState&lt;Conversation | null&gt;(null);\n  const [showDetailModal, setShowDetailModal] = useState(false);\n\n  const formatDaysAgo = (date: Date) =&gt; {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date);\n    const diff = now.getTime() - d.getTime();\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (days &lt; 1) return \"今天\";\n    if (days &lt; 30) return &#96;${days}天前&#96;;\n    if (days &lt; 365) return &#96;${Math.floor(days / 30)}个月前&#96;;\n    return &#96;${Math.floor(days / 365)}年前&#96;;\n  };\n\n  // 获取对话的首个问题作为标题\n  const getFirstQuestion = (conversation: Conversation): string =&gt; {\n    // 优先从消息中获取首个用户问题\n    if (conversation.messages &amp;&amp; conversation.messages.length &gt; 0) {\n      const firstUserMsg = conversation.messages.find((msg) =&gt; msg.role === \"user\");\n      if (firstUserMsg &amp;&amp; firstUserMsg.content) {\n        // 截取前50个字符作为标题\n        const content = firstUserMsg.content.trim();\n        if (content) {\n          return content.length &gt; 50 ? content.substring(0, 50) + \"...\" : content;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    // 如果没有用户消息，尝试从标题中提取（如果标题不是默认的时间戳格式）\n    if (conversation.title &amp;&amp; !conversation.title.startsWith(\"对话 \")) {\n      return conversation.title;\n    }\n    // 最后的后备方案\n    return \"新对话\";\n  };\n\n  const handleConversationClick = (conversation: Conversation) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedConversation(conversation);\n    setShowDetailModal(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDeleteClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, conversationId: string) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n      }\n    },\n    [reportError]\n  );\n\n  const loadConversations = useCallback(async (options?: { refreshActive?: boolean; activeConversationId?: string }) =&gt; {\n    // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n    try {\n      const data = await aiSearchService.getConversations(effectivePageType);\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 加载对话列表，原始数据:', data.length, '条对话');\n      \n      // 按ID去重，保留最新的对话（按updated_at排序）\n      const conversationMap = new Map&lt;string, Conversation&gt;();\n      const duplicateIds: string[] = [];\n      data.forEach((conv) =&gt; {\n        const existing = conversationMap.get(conv.id);\n        if (!existing) {\n          conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\n        } else {\n          duplicateIds.push(conv.id);\n          // 如果已存在，比较更新时间，保留更新的\n          const existingTime = existing.updatedAt instanceof Date \n            ? existing.updatedAt.getTime() \n            : new Date(existing.updatedAt).getTime();\n          const currentTime = conv.updatedAt instanceof Date \n            ? conv.updatedAt.getTime() \n            : new Date(conv.updatedAt).getTime();\n          if (currentTime &gt; existingTime) {\n            conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\n          }\n        }\n      });\n      \n      if (duplicateIds.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.warn('[ConversationDebug] 发现重复的对话ID:', duplicateIds);\n      }\n      \n      // 转换为数组并按更新时间排序\n      const uniqueConversations = Array.from(conversationMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n        const timeA = a.updatedAt instanceof Date ? a.updatedAt.getTime() : new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime();\n        const timeB = b.updatedAt instanceof Date ? b.updatedAt.getTime() : new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime();\n        return timeB - timeA; // 降序排列，最新的在前\n      });\n      \n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 去重后的对话列表:', uniqueConversations.length, '条对话，IDs:', uniqueConversations.map(c =&gt; c.id));\n      setConversations(uniqueConversations);\n\n      if (uniqueConversations.length === 0)\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "### Response\n\n- &#96;data&#96; (array[object]) 会话列表\n    \n    - &#96;id&#96; (string) 会话 ID\n        \n    - &#96;name&#96; (string) 会话名称，默认由大语言模型生成。\n        \n    - &#96;inputs&#96; (object) 用户输入参数。\n        \n    - &#96;status&#96; (string) 会话状态\n        \n    - &#96;introduction&#96; (string) 开场白\n        \n    - &#96;created_at&#96; (timestamp) 创建时间\n        \n    - &#96;updated_at&#96; (timestamp) 更新时间\n        \n- &#96;has_more&#96; (bool)\n    \n- &#96;limit&#96; (int) 返回条数，若传入超过系统限制，返回系统限制数量\n    \n\n### Request\n\nGET\n\n/conversations\n\ncurl -X GET 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/conversations?user=abc-123&amp;last_id=&amp;limit=20'\\\n\n--header 'Authorization: Bearer {api_key}'\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n### Response\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;JSON\n{\n  \"limit\": 20,\n  \"has_more\": false,\n  \"data\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"10799fb8-64f7-4296-bbf7-b42bfbe0ae54\",\n      \"name\": \"New chat\",\n      \"inputs\": {\n          \"book\": \"book\",\n          \"myName\": \"Lucy\"\n      },\n      \"status\": \"normal\",\n      \"created_at\": 1679667915,\n      \"updated_at\": 1679667915\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"hSIhXBhNe8X1d8Et\"\n      // ...\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n---\n\nDELETE/conversations/:conversation_id\n\n## [删除会话](http://47.113.225.93:9999/app/a541096e-d0c1-48f8-98af-df593cf62428/develop#delete)\n\n删除会话。\n\n### Path\n\n- &#96;conversation_id&#96; (string) 会话 ID\n    \n\n### Request Body\n\n- Name&#96;user&#96;TypestringDescription\n    \n- 用户标识，由开发者定义规则，需保证用户标识在应用内唯一。\n    \n\n### Response\n\n- &#96;result&#96; (string) 固定返回 success\n    \n\n### Request\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;SQL\nDELETE\n/conversations/:conversation_id\ncurl -X DELETE 'http://47.113.225.93:9999/v1/conversations/:conversation_id' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Bearer {api_key}' \\\n--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n--data-raw '{\n \"user\": \"abc-123\"\n}'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n### Response\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;Plain\n204 No Content\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nCopyCopied!\n\n---\n\nPOST/conversations/:conversation_id/name\n\n## [会话重命名](http://47.113.225.93:9999/app/a541096e-d0c1-48f8-98af-df593cf62428/develop#rename)\n\n对会话进行重命名，会话名称用于显示在支持多会话的客户端上。",

f.name));\\n      \\n      // 上传文件\\n      const uploadedFiles = await aiSearchService.uploadFiles(fileArray, undefined);\\n      console.log('[文件上传] 文件上传成功:', uploadedFiles);\\n      \\n      // 创建来源信息记录\\n      const createdSources = [];\\n      for (const uploadedFile of uploadedFiles) {\\n        // 如果markdown内容太长，只保存摘要\\n        let description = &amp;#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(uploadedFile.size)}&amp;#96;;\\n        if (uploadedFile.markdownContent) {\\n          // 只保存前500个字符作为描述，完整内容保留在文件记录中\\n          const contentPreview = uploadedFile.markdownContent.length &amp;gt; 500\\n            ? uploadedFile.markdownContent.substring(0, 500) + '...'\\n            : uploadedFile.markdownContent;\\n          description = contentPreview;\\n        }\\n        \\n        const sourceData = {\\n          source_id: uploadedFile.id || uploadedFile.fileId || &amp;#96;file_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&amp;#96;,\\n          title: uploadedFile.name,\\n          type: 'external' as const,\\n          url: uploadedFile.url,\\n          description: description,\\n          page_type: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          conversation_id: null\\n        };\\n        \\n        console.log('[文件上传] 创建来源信息:', sourceData);\\n        \\n        try {\\n          const response = await api.post('/source-information', sourceData);\\n          console.log('[文件上传] 来源信息创建成功:', response.data);\\n          createdSources.push(response.data.data);\\n        } catch (sourceError) {\\n          console.error('[文件上传] 创建来源信息失败:', sourceError);\\n          // 继续处理其他文件，不中断整个流程\\n        }\\n      }\\n      \\n      console.log('[文件上传] 成功创建来源信息数量:', createdSources.length);\\n      \\n      // 等待一小段时间确保数据库已更新，然后重新加载来源列表\\n      await new Promise(resolve =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      await api.delete(&amp;#96;/source-information/${sourceId}&amp;#96;);\\n      await loadSources();\\n      return true;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('删除来源失败:', error);\\n      alert('删除来源失败');\\n      return false;\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\\n    if (bytes &amp;lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\\n  };\\n\\n  const formatDate = (dateString?: string) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!dateString) return '';\\n    const date = new Date(dateString);\\n    return date.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN', {\\n      year: 'numeric',\\n      month: 'long',\\n      day: 'numeric'\\n    });\\n  };\\n\\n  // 过滤检索信息：排除上传的文件，只显示真正的检索信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\n  const filteredSources = sources.filter(source =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的，不是http链接）\\n    if (source.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !source.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !source.url.startsWith('https')) {\\n      return false;\\n    }\\n    // 只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源\\n    return true;\\n  }).filter(source =&amp;gt;\\n    source.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    source.description?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredTechPoints = techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;gt;\\n    tp.name.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    tp.description?.toLowerCase().includes(techPointSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredKnowledgePoints = knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&amp;gt;\\n    kp.title.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    kp.content?.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgeBaseSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const filteredPublicFiles = publicKnowledgeFiles.filter(file =&amp;gt;\\n    file.name.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase()) ||\\n    file.description?.toLowerCase().includes(publicFileSearch.toLowerCase())\\n  );\\n\\n  const toggleTechPoint = (techPointId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedTechPoints(prev =&amp;gt;\\n      prev.includes(techPointId)\\n        ? prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== techPointId)\\n        : [...prev, techPointId]\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (knowledgePointId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =&amp;gt;\\n      prev.includes(knowledgePointId)\\n        ? prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== knowledgePointId)\\n        : [...prev, knowledgePointId]\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  const togglePublicFile = async (fileId: number) =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (selectedPublicFiles.includes(fileId)) {\\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&amp;gt; prev.filter(id =&amp;gt; id !== fileId));\\n    } else {\\n      setSelectedPublicFiles(prev =&amp;gt; [...prev, fileId]);\\n      // 将选中的公共知识库文件添加到项目来源中\\n      if (projectId) {\\n        const file = publicKnowledgeFiles.find(f =&amp;gt; f.id === fileId);\\n        if (file) {\\n          try {\\n            await api.post('/source-information', {\\n              source_id: &amp;#96;public_kb_${file.id}&amp;#96;,\\n              title: file.name,\\n              type: 'knowledge_base',\\n              url: file.file_url || file.file_path,\\n              description: file.description || &amp;#96;公共知识库文件: ${file.name}&amp;#96;,\\n              page_type: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n              conversation_id: null\\n            });\\n            // 重新加载来源列表\\n            await loadSources();\\n          } catch (error) {\\n            console.error('添加公共知识库文件到项目失败:', error);\\n          }\\n        }\\n      }\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleTechnicalTranslation = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsTranslating(true);\\n    setTranslatedContent('');\\n    \\n    try {\\n      const contentParts: string[] = [];\\n      \\n      // 1. 拼接已选择的技术点\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        contentParts.push('## 已选择技术点\\\\n\\\\n');\\n        configuredResources.techPoints.forEach((techPoint, index) =&amp;gt; {\\n          contentParts.push(&amp;#96;### ${index + 1}. ${techPoint.name}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          if (techPoint.description) {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${techPoint.description}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        });\\n        contentParts.push('\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n');\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 2. 拼接已上传的文件（转换为markdown）\\n      if (configuredResources.files.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        contentParts.push('## 已上传文件\\\\n\\\\n');\\n        \\n        // 获取所有文件记录以获取markdown内容\\n        let fileRecords: FileUploadResponse[] = [];\\n        try {\\n          fileRecords = await aiSearchService.getFiles({\\n            pageType: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96; as any\\n          });\\n        } catch (error) {\\n          console.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\\n        }\\n        \\n        for (const file of configuredResources.files) {\\n          contentParts.push(&amp;#96;### ${file.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          \\n          // 尝试从文件记录中获取markdown内容\\n          const fileRecord = fileRecords.find(f =&amp;gt; \\n            f.url === file.url || \\n            f.name === file.title ||\\n            f.id === file.source_id\\n          );\\n          \\n          if (fileRecord?.markdownContent) {\\n            // 使用文件的markdown内容\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${fileRecord.markdownContent}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          } else if (file.description) {\\n            // 如果没有markdown内容，使用description（可能已经包含markdown内容）\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${file.description}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          } else {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;文件：${file.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        }\\n        contentParts.push('\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n');\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 3. 拼接已选择的知识点\\n      if (configuredResources.knowledgePoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        contentParts.push('## 已选择知识点\\\\n\\\\n');\\n        configuredResources.knowledgePoints.forEach((knowledgePoint, index) =&amp;gt; {\\n          contentParts.push(&amp;#96;### ${index + 1}. ${knowledgePoint.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          if (knowledgePoint.content) {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${knowledgePoint.content}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        });\\n        contentParts.push('\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n');\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 4. 拼接互联网信息点\\n      if (configuredResources.internetInfo.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        contentParts.push('## 互联网信息点\\\\n\\\\n');\\n        configuredResources.internetInfo.forEach((info, index) =&amp;gt; {\\n          contentParts.push(&amp;#96;### ${index + 1}. ${info.title}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          if (info.url) {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;链接：${info.url}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n          if (info.description) {\\n            contentParts.push(&amp;#96;${info.description}\\\\n\\\\n&amp;#96;);\\n          }\\n        });\\n      }\\n      \\n      const finalContent = contentParts.join('');\\n      setTranslatedContent(finalContent);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('技术转译失败:', error);\\n      alert('技术转译失败，请重试');\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsTranslating(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleSaveReview = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    setIsSaving(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 更新转译内容\\n      setTranslatedContent(reviewContent);\\n      // 这里可以添加保存到后端的逻辑\\n      // 例如：await api.post(&amp;#96;/projects/${projectId}/translated-content&amp;#96;, { content: reviewContent });\\n      \\n      setShowReviewModal(false);\\n      alert('内容已保存');\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('保存失败:', error);\\n      alert('保存失败，请重试');\\n    } finally {\\n      setIsSaving(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 总结对话内容并保存为来源信息\\n  const summarizeAndSaveConversation = async (targetPageType?: string, messages?: Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;): Promise&amp;lt;string | null&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 使用传入的消息列表，如果没有则使用状态中的消息\\n    const messagesToUse = messages || aiMessages;\\n    \\n    // 如果没有对话内容，直接返回 null\\n    if (messagesToUse.length === 0) {\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果没有指定pageType，使用project-{projectId}格式\\n    const pageType = targetPageType || (projectId ? &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96; : undefined);\\n\\n    setIsSummarizingConversation(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 构建对话文本\\n      const conversationText = messagesToUse.map((msg) =&amp;gt; {\\n        const role = msg.sender === 'user' ? '用户' : 'AI助手';\\n        return &amp;#96;${role}: ${msg.content}&amp;#96;;\\n      }).join('\\\\n\\\\n');\\n\\n      // 如果对话文本太长，先截断（保留前2000字符）\\n      const maxLength = 2000;\\n      const truncatedText = conversationText.length &amp;gt; maxLength \\n        ? conversationText.substring(0, maxLength) + '\\\\n\\\\n...（内容已截断）'\\n        : conversationText;\\n\\n      // 生成总结（简化版本：使用对话内容作为描述，标题为总结）\\n      // 如果对话很长，取前100字符作为标题\\n      let summaryTitle = '项目资源对话摘要';\\n      let summaryDescription = truncatedText;\\n\\n      // 尝试使用 AI 生成更智能的总结\\n      try {\\n        const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n        const summaryPrompt = &amp;#96;请对以下对话进行总结，生成一个简洁的标题（不超过30字）和一段摘要（不超过300字）。用中文回答，格式为：\\n标题：[标题]\\n摘要：[摘要内容]\\n\\n对话内容：\\n${truncatedText}&amp;#96;;\\n\\n        const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n          summaryPrompt,\\n          { context: [{ role: 'user', content: summaryPrompt }] },\\n          (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n          undefined\\n        );\\n\\n        if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n          const aiResponse = result.data.answer || result.data.result || '';\\n          // 解析 AI 响应，提取标题和摘要\\n          const titleMatch = aiResponse.match(/标题[：:]\\\\s*(.+)/);\\n          const summaryMatch = aiResponse.match(/摘要[：:]\\\\s*(.+?)(?:\\\\n|$)/s);\\n          \\n          if (titleMatch &amp;amp;&amp;amp; titleMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryTitle = titleMatch[1].trim();\\n          }\\n          if (summaryMatch &amp;amp;&amp;amp; summaryMatch[1]) {\\n            summaryDescription = summaryMatch[1].trim();\\n            // 如果 AI 生成的摘要太短，补充完整对话内容\\n            if (summaryDescription.length &amp;lt; '...' : ''),\\n        status: 'active'\\n      });\\n\\n      // 保存用户消息\\n      const userMessageId = &amp;#96;user_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&amp;#96;;\\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\\n        message_id: userMessageId,\\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\\n        message_type: 'user',\\n        content: userQuery,\\n        query: userQuery,\\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\\n        status: 'completed'\\n      });\\n\\n      // 保存助手回复\\n      const assistantMessageId = &amp;#96;assistant_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&amp;#96;;\\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\\n        message_id: assistantMessageId,\\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\\n        message_type: 'assistant',\\n        content: response.content,\\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\\n        prompt_tokens: response.usage.promptTokens,\\n        completion_tokens: response.usage.completionTokens,\\n        total_tokens: response.usage.totalTokens,\\n        status: 'completed'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('保存消息历史失败:', error);\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响主流程\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 生成对话ID\\n   */\\n  private generateConversationId(): string {\\n    return &amp;#96;conv-${Date.now()}-${uuidv4()}&amp;#96;;\\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 3917,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class ChatMessageService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 保存Dify工作流响应到数据库\\n   */\\n  static async saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\\n    response: DifyWorkflowResponse,\\n    userQuery: string,\\n    appType: string,\\n    inputs?: any,\\n    existingConversationId?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; workflowExecution: WorkflowExecutionRecord }&amp;gt; {\\n    // 使用传入的conversation_id或生成新的对话ID\\n    const conversationId = existingConversationId || response.workflow_run_id;\\n    \\n    // 创建或更新对话记录\\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\\n      conversation_id: conversationId,\\n      session_name: userQuery || &amp;#96;${appType}工作流&amp;#96;,\\n      app_type: existingConversationId ? 'ai-search' : appType, // 如果是关联的工作流，保持原始类型\\n      status: 'active',\\n      metadata: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined\\n    });\\n\\n    // 保存工作流执行记录\\n    const workflowExecution = await this.saveWorkflowExecution({\\n      workflow_run_id: response.workflow_run_id,\\n      task_id: response.task_id,\\n      workflow_id: response.data?.workflow_id,\\n      app_type: appType,\\n      status: response.data?.status || 'completed',\\n      error_message: response.data?.error || undefined,\\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined,\\n      outputs: response.data?.outputs ? JSON.stringify(response.data.outputs) : undefined,\\n      elapsed_time: response.data?.elapsed_time,\\n      total_tokens: response.data?.total_tokens,\\n      total_steps: response.data?.total_steps,\\n      started_at: response.data?.created_at ? new Date(response.data.created_at * 1000).toISOString() : undefined,\\n      finished_at: response.data?.finished_at ? new Date(response.data.finished_at * 1000).toISOString() : undefined\\n    });\\n\\n    return { conversation, workflowExecution };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 获取对话历史消息\\n   */\\n  static async getConversationMessages(conversationId: string, limit: number = 50, offset: number = 0): Promise&amp;lt;ChatMessageRecord[]&amp;gt; {\\n    \\n  }\\n}\","

                  "lineNumber": 4164,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      clearGlobalError();\\n      // 提出新问题时，清空勾选状态和已发送来源\\n      setSelectedSourceIds([]);\\n      setSentSourceIds([]);\\n      \\n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\\n        title: &amp;#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\\\//g, '/')}&amp;#96;,\\n        sources: [], // 新对话不附带来源，等用户勾选后首次发送时传递\\n        pageType: effectivePageType, // 使用包含项目ID的 pageType\\n      });\\n\\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\\n      }\\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"创建新对话失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"创建新对话失败，请稍后重试\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n    }\\n  }, [\\n    clearGlobalError,\\n    reportError,\\n    selectedWorkflowId,\\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\\n    loadConversations,\\n    effectivePageType,\\n  ]);\\n\\n  const handleShowHistory = useCallback(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowConversationList(true);\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 标记来源已发送给 Dify，避免重复发送\\n  const handleSourcesSent = useCallback((sourceIds: string[]) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSentSourceIds(prev =&amp;gt; {\\n      const newIds = sourceIds.filter(id =&amp;gt; !prev.includes(id));\\n      if (newIds.length === 0) return prev;\\n      return [...prev, ...newIds];\\n    });\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleSelectConversation = async (conversation: Conversation)\\n;\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 12157,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback(async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      clearGlobalError();\\n      // 提出新问题时，清空勾选状态和已发送来源\\n      setSelectedSourceIds([]);\\n      setSentSourceIds([]);\\n      \\n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\\n        title: &amp;#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\\\//g, '/')}&amp;#96;,\\n        sources: [], // 新对话不附带来源，等用户勾选后首次发送时传递\\n        pageType: effectivePageType, // 使用包含项目ID的 pageType\\n      });\\n\\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\\n      }\\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"创建新对话失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"创建新对话失败，请稍后重试\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n    }\\n  }, [\\n    clearGlobalError,\\n    reportError,\\n    selectedWorkflowId,\\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\\n    loadConversations,\\n    effectivePageType,\\n  ]);\\n\\n  const handleShowHistory = useCallback(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    setShowConversationList(true);\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 标记来源已发送给 Dify，避免重复发送\\n  const handleSourcesSent = useCallback((sourceIds: string[]) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSentSourceIds(prev =&amp;gt; {\\n      const newIds = sourceIds.filter(id =&amp;gt; !prev.includes(id));\\n      if (newIds.length === 0) return prev;\\n      return [...prev, ...newIds];\\n    });\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const handleSelectConversation = async (conversation: Conversation)\\n;\\n;\","

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';\\nimport { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\\nimport { Upload, Search, X, url?: string;\\n  description?: string;\\n  created_at: string;\\n  metadata?: any;\\n  category?: SourceCategory;\\n}\\n\\nconst ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const { projectId } = useParams&amp;lt;{ projectId: string }&amp;gt;();\\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const techPointSelectorRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  const [project, setProject] = useState&amp;lt;Project | null&amp;gt;(null);\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\n  const [sources, useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedKnowledgePoints, setSelectedKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [techPoints, setTechPoints] = useState&amp;lt;TechPoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [knowledgePoints, setKnowledgePoints] = useState&amp;lt;KnowledgePoint[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [publicKnowledgeFiles, setPublicKnowledgeFiles] = useState&amp;lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [selectedPublicFiles, setSelectedPublicFiles] = useState&amp;lt;number[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTechPointSelector, setShowTechPointSelector] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgeBaseSelector, setShowKnowledgeBaseSelector] = useState(false);\\n  const [techPointSearch, setTechPointSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [knowledgeBaseSearch, setKnowledgeBaseSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [publicFileSearch, setPublicFileSearch] = useState('');\\n  const [configuredResources, setConfiguredResources] = useState&amp;lt;{\\n    files: SourceInformation[];\\n    internetInfo: SourceInformation[];\\n    techPoints: TechPoint[];\\n    knowledgePoints: KnowledgePoint[];\\n  }&amp;gt;({\\n    files: [],\\n    internetInfo: [],\\n    techPoints: [],\\n    knowledgePoints: []\\n  });\\n  const [isTranslating, setIsTranslating] = useState(false);\\n  const [translatedContent, setTranslatedContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [showReviewModal, setShowReviewModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [reviewContent, setReviewContent] = useState&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;('');\\n  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);\\n  const [showTechPointModal, setShowTechPointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showFileUploadModal, setShowFileUploadModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showKnowledgePointModal, setShowKnowledgePointModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [showInternetInfoModal, setShowInternetInfoModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [isSummarizingConversation, setIsSummarizingConversation] = useState(false);\\n  const [showHistoryModal, setShowHistoryModal] = useState(false);\\n  const [historyRecords, setHistoryRecords] = useState&amp;lt;SourceInformation[]&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [historyLoading, setHistoryLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [showHistoryView, setShowHistoryView] = useState(false); // 控制显示历史记录视图还是AI共创视图\\n  const [checkingHistory, setCheckingHistory] = useState(true); // 检查历史记录中\\n  const fileInputRefModal = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLInputElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n  \\n  // AI问答相关状态\\n  const [aiMessages, setAiMessages] = useState&amp;lt;Array&amp;lt;{ id: string; content: string; sender: 'user' | 'ai'; timestamp: Date }&amp;gt;&amp;gt;([]);\\n  const [aiInputMessage, setAiInputMessage] = useState('');\\n  const [aiLoading, setAiLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [aiConversationId, setAiConversationId] = useState&amp;lt;string | undefined&amp;gt;(undefined);\\n  const aiMessagesEndRef = useRef&amp;lt;HTMLDivElement&amp;gt;(null);\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (projectId) {\\n      loadProject();\\n      loadSources();\\n      loadTechPoints();\\n      loadPublicKnowledgeFiles();\\n      checkHistoryRecords(); // 检查历史记录\\n    }\\n  }, [projectId]);\\n\\n  // AI消息自动滚动到底部\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    aiMessagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\\n  }, [aiMessages]);\\n\\n  // AI问答发送消息\\n  const handleAISendMessage = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!aiInputMessage.trim() || aiLoading) return;\\n\\n    const userMessage = {\\n      id: Date.now().toString(),\\n      content: aiInputMessage.trim(),\\n      sender: 'user' as const,\\n      timestamp: new Date(),\\n    };\\n\\n    setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, userMessage]);\\n    const currentMessage = aiInputMessage.trim();\\n    setAiInputMessage('');\\n    setAiLoading(true);\\n\\n    try {\\n      // 获取智能工作流AI问答的Dify配置\\n      const aiQAConfig = await configService.getDifyConfig('smart-workflow-ai-qa');\\n\\n      // 构建上下文信息（包含项目资源）\\n      const contextMessages = aiMessages.map((msg) =&amp;gt; ({\\n        role: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',\\n        content: msg.content,\\n      }));\\n\\n      // 添加项目资源信息到上下文\\n      const resourceContext: string[] = [];\\n      if (configuredResources.techPoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的技术点：${configuredResources.techPoints.map(tp =&amp;gt; tp.name).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.files.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已上传的文件：${configuredResources.files.map(f =&amp;gt; f.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n      if (configuredResources.knowledgePoints.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        resourceContext.push(&amp;#96;已选择的知识点：${configuredResources.knowledgePoints.map(kp =&amp;gt; kp.title).join('、')}&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n\\n      const inputs: any = {\\n        context: contextMessages,\\n      };\\n\\n      if (resourceContext.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n        inputs.projectResources = resourceContext.join('\\\\n');\\n      }\\n\\n      // 调用AI问答API\\n      const result = await workflowAPI.aiSearch(\\n        currentMessage,\\n        inputs,\\n        (aiQAConfig &amp;amp;&amp;amp; aiQAConfig.enabled) ? aiQAConfig : undefined,\\n        aiConversationId || undefined\\n      );\\n\\n      let responseContent = '抱歉，我无法处理您的请求。';\\n\\n      if (result.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; result.data) {\\n        responseContent = result.data.answer || result.data.result || responseContent;\\n        // 更新conversationId以支持多轮对话\\n        if (result.data.conversation_id) {\\n          setAiConversationId(result.data.conversation_id);\\n        }\\n      } else {\\n        responseContent = result.error || responseContent;\\n      }\\n\\n      const aiMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: responseContent,\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, aiMessage]);\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('AI问答API调用失败:', error);\\n      const errorMessage = {\\n        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),\\n        content: '抱歉，AI服务暂时不可用，请稍后重试。',\\n        sender: 'ai' as const,\\n        timestamp: new Date(),\\n      };\\n      setAiMessages((prev) =&amp;gt; [...prev, errorMessage]);\\n    } finally {\\n      setAiLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\\\"检索信息\\\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\\n      return s.type === 'external' &amp;amp;&amp;amp; s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https');\\n    });\\n    // 互联网信息点：排除上传的文件，只包含真正的互联网信息（http/https链接或文本来源）\\n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&amp;gt; {\\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\\n      if (s.url &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('http') &amp;amp;&amp;amp; !s.url.startsWith('https')) {\\n        return false;\\n      }\\n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\\n      return true;\\n    });\\n    \\n    setConfiguredResources({\\n      files: files,\\n      internetInfo: internetInfo,\\n      techPoints: techPoints.filter(tp =&amp;gt; selectedTechPoints.includes(tp.id)),\\n      knowledgePoints: knowledgePoints.filter(kp =&amp;gt; selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id))\\n    });\\n  }, [sources, selectedTechPoints, selectedKnowledgePoints, techPoints, knowledgePoints]);\\n\\n  const loadProject = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    try {\\n      const response = await projectService.getProjectById(parseInt(projectId));\\n      if (response.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data) {\\n        setProject(response.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  const loadSources = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    try {\\n      // 获取项目的来源信息\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\n        params: {\\n          pageType: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 100\\n        }\\n      });\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        setSources(response.data.data);\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('加载来源信息失败:', error);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // 检查历史记录（用于决定显示哪个视图）\\n  const checkHistoryRecords = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n    if (!projectId) return;\\n    setCheckingHistory(true);\\n    try {\\n      // 获取项目的所有来源信息\\n      const response = await api.get('/source-information', {\\n        params: {\\n          pageType: &amp;#96;project-${projectId}&amp;#96;,\\n          page: 1,\\n          pageSize: 1000\\n        }\\n      });\\n      if (response.data.success &amp;amp;&amp;amp; response.data.data) {\\n        // 过滤出历史记录（AI问答、技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿）\\n        const historyCategories = ['ai-qa-summary', 'tech-package-qa', 'tech-strategy-qa', 'tech-article-qa', 'technical-translation'];\\n        const filtered = response.data.data.filter((source: SourceInformation) =&amp;gt;                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class ChatMessageService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 保存Dify工作流响应到数据库\\n   */\\n  static async saveDifyWorkflowResponse(\\n    response: DifyWorkflowResponse,\\n    userQuery: string,\\n    appType: string,\\n    inputs?: any,\\n    existingConversationId?: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; workflowExecution: WorkflowExecutionRecord }&amp;gt; {\\n    // 使用传入的conversation_id或生成新的对话ID\\n    const conversationId = existingConversationId || response.workflow_run_id;\\n    \\n    // 创建或更新对话记录\\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\\n      conversation_id: conversationId,\\n      session_name: userQuery || &amp;#96;${appType}工作流&amp;#96;,\\n      app_type: existingConversationId ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined\\n    });\\n\\n    // 保存工作流执行记录\\n    const workflowExecution = await this.saveWorkflowExecution({\\n      workflow_run_id: response.workflow_run_id,\\n      task_id: response.task_id,\\n      workflow_id: response.data?.workflow_id,\\n      app_type: appType,\\n      status: response.data?.status || 'completed',\\n      error_message: response.data?.error || undefined,\\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined,\\n      outputs: response.data?.outputs ?                   "content": "        \"contents\": \"export class AiSearchService {\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 发送消息\\n   */\\n  async sendMessage(\\n    conversationId: string,\\n    role: 'user' | 'assistant',\\n    content: string,\\n    sources: any[] = [],\\n    files: any[] = [],\\n    outputs?: any // 输出字段（用于保存提取的工作流输出）\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;MessageRecord&amp;gt; {\\n    const id = uuidv4();\\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\\n    \\n    // 准备outputs字段（包含提取的输出字段）\\n    const outputsJson = outputs ? JSON.stringify(outputs) : null;\\n    \\n    await db.query(\\n      &amp;#96;INSERT INTO ai_search_messages (id, conversation_id, role, content, sources, outputs, created_at)\\n       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)&amp;#96;,\\n      [\\n        id,\\n        conversationId,\\n        role,\\n        content,\\n        sources.length &amp;gt; 0 ? {\\\\n    // 收集所有需要保存的来源 ID\\\\n    const sourceIds: string[] = [];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 1. 总结并保存对话内容\\\\n    const conversationSourceId = await summarizeAndSaveConversation(pageType);\\\\n    if (conversationSourceId) {\\\\n      sourceIds.push(conversationSourceId);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 2. 保存技术转译内容\\\\n    const translationSourceId = await saveTechnicalTranslationAsSource(pageType);\\\\n    if (translationSourceId) {\\\\n      sourceIds.push(translationSourceId);\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 构建跳转 URL\\\\n    let url = &amp;amp;#96;/${pageType}&amp;amp;#96;;\\\\n    const params = new URLSearchParams();\\\\n    \\\\n    if (projectId) {\\\\n      params.append('projectId', projectId);\\\\n      // 添加 newConversation 参数，确保创建新对话\\\\n      params.append('newConversation', 'true');\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    // 添加所有 sourceId（支持多个）\\\\n    sourceIds.forEach(sourceId =&amp;amp;gt;                   "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;amp;gt; = \\\\n\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载对话历史和输出内容\\\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    // 如果 URL 中有 newConversation 参数，清除当前对话，确保创建新对话\\\\n    if (shouldCreateNewConversation &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; currentConversation) {\\\\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 检测到 newConversation 参数，清除当前对话');\\\\n      setCurrentConversation(null);\\\\n      // 清除 URL 参数，避免刷新时重复清除\\\\n      const newSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);\\\\n      newSearchParams.delete('newConversation');\\\\n      setSearchParams(newSearchParams, { replace: true });\\\\n    }\\\\n    \\\\n    loadConversations();\\\\n    loadOutputs();\\\\n    loadWorkflowConfig();\\\\n    loadFiles();\\\\n    \\\\n    // 加载页面类型的来源信息（始终加载，作为基础来源）\\\\n    loadPageTypeSources();\\\\n    \\\\n    const handleFilesUploaded = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      loadFiles();\\\\n    };\\\\n    window.addEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\\\\n    \\\\n    return () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      window.removeEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\\\\n    };\\\\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\\\\n  }, []);\\\\n\\\\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\\\\n;\\\",\""

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"import { aiRoleModel } from '../../models';\\nimport { DirectAgentConfig, ToolConfig } from '../../models/AIRole';\\nimport { PromptManager } from './PromptManager';\\nimport { ContextManager } from './ContextManager';\\nimport { ToolExecutor } from './ToolExecutor';\\nimport { ILLMProvider, ChatMessage, LLMConfig, LLMResponse, Tool } from '../llm/types';\\nimport { OpenAIProvider } from '../llm/OpenAIProvider';\\nimport { ChatMessageService } from '../ChatMessageService';\\nimport { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';\\n\\n/**\\n * Agent 执行结果\\n */\\nexport interface AgentExecutionResult {\\n  content: string;\\n  conversationId: string;\\n  usage: {\\n    promptTokens: number;\\n    completionTokens: number;\\n    totalTokens: number;\\n  };\\n  metadata?: any;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Agent 编排服务\\n * 负责执行完整的 Agent 流程\\n */\\nexport class AgentOrchestrator {\\n  private promptManager: PromptManager;\\n  private contextManager: ContextManager;\\n  private toolExecutor: ToolExecutor;\\n  private maxToolCallIterations: number = 10; // 防止无限循环\\n\\n  constructor() {\\n    this.promptManager = new PromptManager();\\n    this.contextManager = new ContextManager();\\n    this.toolExecutor = new ToolExecutor();\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\\n   * @param query 用户查询\\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\\n   * @returns 执行结果\\n   */\\n  async executeAgent(\\n    roleId: string,\\n    query: string,\\n    conversationId: string = '',\\n    context: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {}\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;gt; {\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\\n    \\n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\\n    const checkTimeout = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\\n      if (elapsed &amp;gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\\n        throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&amp;#96;);\\n      }\\n    };\\n    \\n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\n    if (!role) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\\n      throw new Error(&amp;#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\n\\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\\n\\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\n      context\\n    );\\n\\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\n      finalConversationId,\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\n      query\\n    );\\n\\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\\n    \\n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\\n      messages.push({\\n        role: 'system',\\n        content: systemPrompt\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\n    messages.push({\\n      role: 'user',\\n      content: query\\n    });\\n\\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\n\\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\n\\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\\n    checkTimeout();\\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\\n\\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\\n\\n    // 10. 返回结果\\n    return {\\n      content: response.content,\\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\\n      usage: response.usage,\\n      metadata: {\\n        model: response.model,\\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\\n      }\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\\n   */\\n  private async executeWithTools(\\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\\n    tools: Tool[],\\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\\n    checkTimeout?: () =&amp;gt; void\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;LLMResponse&amp;gt; {\\n    let iteration = 0;\\n    let currentMessages = [...messages];\\n    let lastResponse: LLMResponse;\\n\\n    while (iteration &amp;lt; this.maxToolCallIterations) {\\n      // 检查超时\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\n        checkTimeout();\\n      }\\n      \\n      // 调用 LLM\\n      const response = await provider.chat(currentMessages, llmConfig, tools.length &amp;gt; 0 ? tools : undefined);\\n      lastResponse = response;\\n\\n      // LLM 调用后检查超时\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\n        checkTimeout();\\n      }\\n\\n      // 如果没有工具调用，直接返回\\n      if (!response.toolCalls || response.toolCalls.length === 0) {\\n        return response;\\n      }\\n\\n      // 将 assistant 的回复添加到消息历史\\n      currentMessages.push({\\n        role: 'assistant',\\n        content: response.content || ''\\n      });\\n\\n      // 执行工具调用（检查超时）\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\n        checkTimeout();\\n      }\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, toolConfigs, checkTimeout);\\n\\n      // 工具执行后检查超时\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\n        checkTimeout();\\n      }\\n\\n      // 将工具调用结果添加到消息历史\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\n        currentMessages.push({\\n          role: 'tool',\\n          content: result.content,\\n          name: result.toolName,\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\n        });\\n      }\\n\\n      iteration++;\\n    }\\n\\n    // 如果达到最大迭代次数，返回最后一次响应\\n    if (iteration &amp;gt;= this.maxToolCallIterations) {\\n      console.warn(&amp;#96;工具调用达到最大迭代次数: ${this.maxToolCallIterations}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n\\n    return lastResponse!;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 执行多个工具调用\\n   */\\n  private async executeTools(\\n    toolCalls: any[],\\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\\n    checkTimeout?: () =&amp;gt; void\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;Array&amp;lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&amp;gt;&amp;gt; {\\n    const results = [];\\n    const TOOL_TIMEOUT = 60000; // 每个工具调用60秒超时\\n\\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\\n      // 在每个工具调用前检查超时\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\n        checkTimeout();\\n      }\\n      \\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&amp;gt; t.enabled &amp;amp;&amp;amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\\n      \\n      if (!config) {\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&amp;#96; })\\n        });\\n        continue;\\n      }\\n\\n      try {\\n        // 使用 ToolExecutor 执行工具，添加超时控制\\n        const result = await Promise.race([\\n          this.toolExecutor.executeTool(toolCall, config),\\n          new Promise&amp;lt;string&amp;gt;((_, reject) =&amp;gt; \\n            setTimeout(() =&amp;gt; reject(new Error(&amp;#96;工具调用超时: ${toolCall.function.name} (${TOOL_TIMEOUT / 1000}秒)&amp;#96;)), TOOL_TIMEOUT)\\n          )\\n        ]);\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: result\\n        });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.error(&amp;#96;工具执行失败: ${toolCall.function.name}&amp;#96;, error);\\n        results.push({\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ \\n            error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '工具执行失败' \\n          })\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    return results;\\n  }\\n\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 准备工具定义（转换为 OpenAI Function 格式）\\n   */\\n  private prepareTools(toolConfigs: ToolConfig[]): Tool[] {\\n    return toolConfigs\\n      .filter(tool =&amp;gt; tool.enabled)\\n      .map(tool =&amp;gt; ({\\n        type: 'function' as const,\\n        function: {\\n          name: tool.name,\\n          description: tool.description,\\n          parameters: {\\n            type: 'object',\\n            properties: this.buildToolProperties(tool.parameters),\\n            required: tool.parameters\\n              .filter(p =&amp;gt; p.required)\\n              .map(p =&amp;gt; p.name)\\n          }\\n        }\\n      }));\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 构建工具参数属性\\n   */\\n  private buildToolProperties(parameters: ToolConfig['parameters']): Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; {\\n    const properties: Record&amp;lt;string, any&amp;gt; = {};\\n\\n    for (const param of parameters) {\\n      properties[param.name] = {\\n        type: param.type,\\n        description: param.description\\n      };\\n\\n      if (param.enum) {\\n        properties[param.name].enum = param.enum;\\n      }\\n\\n      if (param.default !== undefined) {\\n        properties[param.name].default = param.default;\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    return properties;\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 根据配置获取 LLM Provider\\n   */\\n  private getProvider(llmConfig: LLMConfig): ILLMProvider {\\n    switch (llmConfig.provider) {\\n      case 'openai':\\n        return new OpenAIProvider(llmConfig.apiKey, llmConfig.apiBaseUrl);\\n      \\n      // TODO: 其他 Provider（Phase 5）\\n      default:\\n        throw new Error(&amp;#96;不支持的 LLM Provider: ${llmConfig.provider}&amp;#96;);\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 保存消息历史\\n   */\\n  private async saveMessages(\\n    conversationId: string,\\n    userQuery: string,\\n    response: LLMResponse,\\n    roleId: string\\n  ): Promise&amp;lt;void&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // 创建或更新对话会话\\n      await ChatMessageService.upsertConversation({\\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\\n        session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &amp;gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\\n        status: 'active'\\n      });\\n\\n      // 保存用户消息\\n      const userMessageId = &amp;#96;user_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&amp;#96;;\\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\\n        message_id: userMessageId,\\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\\n        message_type: 'user',\\n        content: userQuery,\\n        query: userQuery,\\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\\n        status: 'completed'\\n      });\\n\\n      // 保存助手回复\\n      const assistantMessageId = &amp;#96;assistant_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&amp;#96;;\\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\\n        message_id: assistantMessageId,\\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\\n        message_type: 'assistant',\\n        content: response.content,\\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\\n        prompt_tokens: response.usage.promptTokens,\\n        completion_tokens: response.usage.completionTokens,\\n        total_tokens: response.usage.totalTokens,\\n        status: 'completed'\\n      });\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error('保存消息历史失败:', error);\\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响主流程\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * 生成对话ID\\n   */\\n  private generateConversationId(): string {\\n    return &amp;#96;conv-${Date.now()}-${uuidv4()}&amp;#96;;\\n  }\\n}\\n\\n\","
                },

prev.forEach(s =&amp;amp;gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\\\\n          // 再添加数据库中的来源（会覆盖重复的）\\\\n          sourceResult.data!.forEach(s =&amp;amp;gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\\\\n          const merged = console.error(\\\\\\\"[SourceInfo] 加载页面类型来源信息失败:\\\\\\\", error);\\\\n      // 不阻止页面加载，只记录错误\\\\n    }\\\\n  }, [config.pageType]);\\\\n\\\\n  // 检查 URL 参数中的 sourceId 并自动选中（支持多个 sourceId）\\\\n &amp;amp;gt; 0) {\\\\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 检测到 URL 参数中的 sourceIds:', urlSourceIds);\\\\n      \\\\n      const newSelectedIds: string[] = [];\\\\n      let hasNewSelection = false;\\\\n setEnabledToolIds(dbConfig.enabledToolIds);\\\\n          setDynamicLabelMap(dbConfig.featureLabelMap || {});\\\\n          return;\\\\n        }\\\\n\\\\n        // 2. 如果没有数据库配置，尝试从字段映射配置中加载\\\\n '../ChatMessageService';\\\\nimport { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * Agent 执行结果\\\\n */\\\\nexport interface AgentExecutionResult {\\\\n  content: string;\\\\n  conversationId: string;\\\\n  usage: {\\\\n    promptTokens: number;\\\\n    completionTokens: number;\\\\n    totalTokens: number;\\\\n  };\\\\n  metadata?: any;\\\\n}\\\\n\\\\n/**\\\\n * Agent 编排服务\\\\n * 负责执行完整的 Agent 流程\\\\n */\\\\nexport class AgentOrchestrator {\\\\n  private promptManager: PromptManager;\\\\n  private contextManager: ContextManager;\\\\n  private toolExecutor: ToolExecutor;\\\\n  private maxToolCallIterations: number = 10; // 防止无限循环\\\\n\\\\n  constructor() {\\\\n    this.promptManager = new PromptManager();\\\\n    this.contextManager = new ContextManager();\\\\n    this.toolExecutor = new ToolExecutor();\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 执行 Agent（核心方法）\\\\n   * @param roleId 角色ID\\\\n   * @param query 用户查询\\\\n   * @param conversationId 对话ID（可选，如果不存在会生成新的）\\\\n   * @param context 上下文数据（用于变量替换）\\\\n   * @returns 执行结果\\\\n   */\\\\n  async executeAgent(\\\\n    roleId: string,\\\\n    query: string,\\\\n    conversationId: string = '',\\\\n    context: Record&amp;amp;lt;string, any&amp;amp;gt; = {}\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;AgentExecutionResult&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const startTime = Date.now();\\\\n    const MAX_EXECUTION_TIME = 360000; // 6分钟总体超时（留出缓冲给前端7分钟超时）\\\\n    \\\\n    // 检查超时的辅助函数\\\\n    const checkTimeout = () =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n      const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;\\\\n      if (elapsed &amp;amp;gt; MAX_EXECUTION_TIME) {\\\\n        throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;Agent执行超时：已执行 ${Math.round(elapsed / 1000)} 秒，超过最大执行时间 ${MAX_EXECUTION_TIME / 1000} 秒&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n    \\\\n    // 1. 获取 Agent 配置\\\\n    checkTimeout();\\\\n    const role = await aiRoleModel.getById(roleId);\\\\n    if (!role) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;AI角色不存在: ${roleId}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    if (!role.agentConfig) {\\\\n      throw new Error(&amp;amp;#96;Agent配置不存在: ${roleId}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    const config = role.agentConfig;\\\\n\\\\n    // 2. 生成或使用 conversationId\\\\n    const finalConversationId = conversationId || this.generateConversationId();\\\\n\\\\n    // 3. 渲染 System Prompt\\\\n    const systemPrompt = this.promptManager.renderPrompt(\\\\n      config.prompt.systemPrompt,\\\\n      config.prompt.variables || [],\\\\n      context\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // 4. 获取上下文消息\\\\n    checkTimeout();\\\\n    const contextMessages = await this.contextManager.getContextMessages(\\\\n      finalConversationId,\\\\n      config.contextStrategy,\\\\n      query\\\\n    );\\\\n\\\\n    // 5. 构建完整消息列表\\\\n    const messages: ChatMessage[] = [];\\\\n    \\\\n    // 根据策略决定是否包含 system prompt\\\\n    if (config.contextStrategy.includeSystemPrompt || contextMessages.length === 0) {\\\\n      messages.push({\\\\n        role: 'system',\\\\n        content: systemPrompt\\\\n      });\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    messages.push(...contextMessages);\\\\n    messages.push({\\\\n      role: 'user',\\\\n      content: query\\\\n    });\\\\n\\\\n    // 6. 准备工具定义（Function Calling）\\\\n    const tools = this.prepareTools(config.tools || []);\\\\n\\\\n    // 7. 获取 LLM Provider\\\\n    const provider = this.getProvider(config.llm);\\\\n\\\\n    // 8. 调用 LLM（可能包含多轮工具调用）\\\\n    checkTimeout();\\\\n    let response = await this.executeWithTools(provider, messages, config.llm, tools, config.tools || [], checkTimeout);\\\\n\\\\n    // 9. 保存消息历史\\\\n    await this.saveMessages(finalConversationId, query, response, roleId);\\\\n\\\\n    // 10. 返回结果\\\\n    return {\\\\n      content: response.content,\\\\n      conversationId: finalConversationId,\\\\n      usage: response.usage,\\\\n      metadata: {\\\\n        model: response.model,\\\\n        finishReason: response.finishReason,\\\\n        toolCalls: response.toolCalls?.length || 0\\\\n      }\\\\n    };\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 执行带工具调用的 LLM 请求（可能多轮）\\\\n   */\\\\n  private async executeWithTools(\\\\n    provider: ILLMProvider,\\\\n    messages: ChatMessage[],\\\\n    llmConfig: LLMConfig,\\\\n    tools: Tool[],\\\\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\\\\n    checkTimeout?: () =&amp;amp;gt; void\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;LLMResponse&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    let iteration = 0;\\\\n    let currentMessages = [...messages];\\\\n    let lastResponse: LLMResponse;\\\\n\\\\n    while (iteration &amp;amp;lt; this.maxToolCallIterations) {\\\\n      // 检查超时\\\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\\\n        checkTimeout();\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      // 调用 LLM\\\\n      const response = await provider.chat(currentMessages, llmConfig, tools.length &amp;amp;gt; 0 ? tools : undefined);\\\\n      lastResponse = response;\\\\n\\\\n      // LLM 调用后检查超时\\\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\\\n        checkTimeout();\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 如果没有工具调用，直接返回\\\\n      if (!response.toolCalls || response.toolCalls.length === 0) {\\\\n        return response;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 将 assistant 的回复添加到消息历史\\\\n      currentMessages.push({\\\\n        role: 'assistant',\\\\n        content: response.content || ''\\\\n      });\\\\n\\\\n      // 执行工具调用（检查超时）\\\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\\\n        checkTimeout();\\\\n      }\\\\n      const toolResults = await this.executeTools(response.toolCalls, toolConfigs, checkTimeout);\\\\n\\\\n      // 工具执行后检查超时\\\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\\\n        checkTimeout();\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      // 将工具调用结果添加到消息历史\\\\n      for (const result of toolResults) {\\\\n        currentMessages.push({\\\\n          role: 'tool',\\\\n          content: result.content,\\\\n          name: result.toolName,\\\\n          tool_call_id: result.toolCallId\\\\n        });\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      iteration++;\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    // 如果达到最大迭代次数，返回最后一次响应\\\\n    if (iteration &amp;amp;gt;= this.maxToolCallIterations) {\\\\n      console.warn(&amp;amp;#96;工具调用达到最大迭代次数: ${this.maxToolCallIterations}&amp;amp;#96;);\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    return lastResponse!;\\\\n  }\\\\n\\\\n  /**\\\\n   * 执行多个工具调用\\\\n   */\\\\n  private async executeTools(\\\\n    toolCalls: any[],\\\\n    toolConfigs: ToolConfig[],\\\\n    checkTimeout?: () =&amp;amp;gt; void\\\\n  ): Promise&amp;amp;lt;Array&amp;amp;lt;{ toolCallId: string; toolName: string; content: string }&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n    const results = [];\\\\n    const TOOL_TIMEOUT = 60000; // 每个工具调用60秒超时\\\\n\\\\n    for (const toolCall of toolCalls) {\\\\n      // 在每个工具调用前检查超时\\\\n      if (checkTimeout) {\\\\n        checkTimeout();\\\\n      }\\\\n      \\\\n      const config = toolConfigs.find(t =&amp;amp;gt; t.enabled &amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp; t.name === toolCall.function.name);\\\\n      \\\\n      if (!config) {\\\\n        results.push({\\\\n          toolCallId: toolCall.id,\\\\n          toolName: toolCall.function.name,\\\\n          content: JSON.stringify({ error: &amp;amp;#96;工具不存在或已禁用: ${toolCall.function.name}&amp;amp;#96; })\\\\n        });\\\\n        continue;\\\\n      }\\\\n\\\\n      try {\\\\n        // 使用 ToolExecutor
