                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  // 加载对话历史和输出内容\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    // 如果 URL 中有 newConversation 参数，清除当前对话，确保创建新对话\\n    if (shouldCreateNewConversation &amp;amp;&amp;amp; currentConversation) {\\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 检测到 newConversation 参数，清除当前对话');\\n      setCurrentConversation(null);\\n      // 清除 URL 参数，避免刷新时重复清除\\n      const newSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);\\n      newSearchParams.delete('newConversation');\\n      setSearchParams(newSearchParams, { replace: true });\\n    }\\n    \\n    loadConversations();\\n    loadOutputs();\\n    loadWorkflowConfig();\\n    loadFiles();\\n    \\n    // 加载页面类型的来源信息（始终加载，作为基础来源）\\n    loadPageTypeSources();\\n    \\n    const handleFilesUploaded = () =&amp;gt; {\\n      loadFiles();\\n    };\\n    window.addEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\\n    \\n    return () =&amp;gt; {\\n      window.removeEventListener('filesUploaded', handleFilesUploaded);\\n    };\\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\\n;\","

                  "lineNumber": 18180,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&amp;lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&amp;gt; = \\n\\n\\n  const handleSelectionChange = (selectedIds: string[]) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedSourceIds(selectedIds);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateConversation = useCallback(async (): Promise&amp;lt;Conversation | null&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      clearGlobalError();\\n      \\n      // 如果已有当前对话，直接返回，避免重复创建\\n      if (currentConversation) {\\n        console.log('[ConversationDebug] 已有当前对话，跳过创建:', currentConversation.id);\\n        return currentConversation;\\n      }\\n      \\n      const selectedSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;gt; selectedSourceIds.includes(s.id));\\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 创建新对话，来源数量:', selectedSources.length);\\n\\n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\\n        title: &amp;#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\\\//g, '/')}&amp;#96;,\\n        sources: selectedSources,\\n        pageType: effectivePageType, // 使用包含项目ID的 pageType\\n      });\\n\\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 新对话已创建:', conversation.id);\\n\\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\\n      }\\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\\n      return conversation;\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"创建对话失败:\\\", error);\\n      reportError(\\\"创建对话失败，请稍后重试\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n      return null;\\n    }\\n  }, [\\n    clearGlobalError,\\n    sources,\\n    selectedSourceIds,\\n    reportError,\\n    selectedWorkflowId,\\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\\n    loadConversations,\\n    currentConversation,\\n    effectivePageType,\\n  ]);\\n\\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback\\n;\\n;\","

parsed === \\\"object\\\" ? parsed : {};\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.warn(\\\"解析工作流选择缓存失败:\\\", error);\\n      return {};\\n    }\\n  }, [config.workflowSelectionKey]);\\n\\n  const ...workflowSelectionRef.current,\\n        [conversationId || WORKFLOW_DEFAULT_KEY]: workflowId,\\n        [WORKFLOW_DEFAULT_KEY]: workflowId,\\n      };\\n      workflowSelectionRef.current = map;\\n console.warn(\\\"保存工作流选择缓存失败:\\\", error);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    },\\n    [config.workflowSelectionKey]\\n  );\\n\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    workflowSelectionRef.current = setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  const reportError = useCallback((message: string, detail?: unknown) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setGlobalError(message);\\n    if (!detail) {\\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    if (typeof detail === \\\"string\\\") {\\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail);\\n      return;\\n    }\\n\\n    if (detail instanceof Error) {\\n              const timeA = a.createdAt instanceof Date ? a.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();\\n              const timeB = b.createdAt instanceof Date ? b.createdAt.getTime() : new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();\\n              return timeA - timeB;\\n            });\\n            return {\\n              ...detail,\\n              messages: uniqueMessages,\\n            };\\n          }\\n          return detail;\\n        });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        console.error(\\\"加载对话详情失败:\\\", error);\\n        reportError(\\\"加载对话详情失败，请稍后重试\\\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\\n      } finally {\\n        // 清除加载标记\\n        loadingConversationRef.current.delete(conversationId);\\n      }\\n    },\\n    [reportError]\\n  );\\n\\n  const loadConversations = useCallback(async (options?: { refreshActive?: boolean; {\\n        const existing = conversationMap.get(conv.id);\\n        if (!existing) {\\n          conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\\n        } else {\\n          duplicateIds.push(conv.id);\\n          // 如果已存在，比较更新时间，保留更新的\\n          const existingTime = existing.updatedAt instanceof Date \\n            ? existing.updatedAt.getTime() \\n            : new Date(existing.updatedAt).getTime();\\n          const currentTime = conv.updatedAt instanceof Date \\n            ? conv.updatedAt.getTime() \\n            : new Date(conv.updatedAt).getTime();\\n          if (currentTime &amp;gt; {\\n    setSelectedSourceIds(selectedIds);\\n  };\\n\\n  const handleCreateConversation = useCallback(async (): Promise&amp;lt;Conversation | null&amp;gt; =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      clearGlobalError();\\n      \\n      // 如果已有当前对话，直接返回，避免重复创建\\n      if (currentConversation) {\\n        console.log('[ConversationDebug] 已有当前对话，跳过创建:', currentConversation.id);\\n        return currentConversation;\\n      }\\n      \\n      const selectedSources = sources.filter((s) =&amp;gt;         "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\n\n\n  async execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const userMessageRecord = await this.aiSearchService.sendMessage(\n        params.conversationId,\n        'user',\n        params.content,\n        params.sources || [],\n        params.files || []\n      );\n\n      const conversationRecord = await this.aiSearchService.getConversation(params.conversationId);\n\n      try {\n        const requestedWorkflowId = params.workflowId;\n        const finalWorkflowId = requestedWorkflowId || await resolveWorkflowId();\n\n        if (!finalWorkflowId) {\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: '未找到可用的工作流配置',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const mappingConfig = await ensureFieldMappingConfig(this.fieldMappingService, finalWorkflowId);\n\n        if (!mappingConfig) {\n          const message =\n            requestedWorkflowId &amp;&amp; requestedWorkflowId === finalWorkflowId\n              ? &#96;所选工作流(${finalWorkflowId})尚未配置字段映射&#96;\n              : '尚未配置字段映射，请先完成字段映射配置';\n          return success({\n            userMessage: formatMessageRecord(userMessageRecord),\n            error: message,\n            errorDetail: '请在字段映射配置中为该工作流完成输入输出映射',\n          });\n        }\n\n        const conversationData = await this.buildConversationData({\n          conversation: conversationRecord,\n          content: params.content,\n          sources: params.sources,\n          files: params.files,\n          contextWindowSize: params.contextWindowSize,\n          workflowId: finalWorkflowId,\n          fileList: params.fileList,\n          knowledgeBaseNames: params.knowledgeBaseNames,\n        });\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nasync execute(params: {\n    conversationId: string;\n    content: string;\n    sources?: any[];\n    files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n    contextWindowSize?: number;\n    workflowId?: string;\n    fileList?: string;\n    knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n  }): Promise&lt;Result&lt;SendMessageResult&gt;&gt; {\n\n        const workflowInput = mapWorkflowInput(conversationData, mappingConfig.inputMappings);\n\n        // 获取对话的 Dify conversation_id（如果存在），用于多轮对话\n        const difyConversationId = conversationRecord?.difyConversationId || null;\n        \n        logger.info('准备发送消息到Dify工作流', {\n          本地对话ID: params.conversationId,\n          DifyConversationId: difyConversationId || '未设置（首次对话，Dify将返回新的conversation_id）',\n        });\n        \n        // 将 Dify conversation_id 添加到 workflowInput 中，这样 Agent 节点可以获取到\n        if (difyConversationId) {\n          workflowInput.conversationId = difyConversationId;\n          logger.info('已设置Dify conversation_id到工作流输入', { difyConversationId });\n        } else {\n          logger.info('首次对话，未设置Dify conversation_id，Dify将创建新的对话');\n        }\n\n        const workflowResult = await agentWorkflowService.executeWorkflow(finalWorkflowId, {\n          input: workflowInput,\n        });\n\n        // 从工作流执行结果中提取 Dify conversation_id\n        // Agent 节点的输出中可能包含 conversation_id\n        let newDifyConversationId: string | null = null;\n        \n        // 尝试从工作流执行结果的数据中提取 conversation_id\n        // 首先检查 outputs 中是否包含 conversation_id\n        if (workflowResult?.data?.outputs) {\n          const outputs = workflowResult.data.outputs;\n          if (outputs.conversation_id &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.conversation_id === 'string') {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.output &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.output === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.output.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.output.conversation_id;\n          } else if (outputs.metadata &amp;&amp; typeof outputs.metadata === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputs.metadata.conversation_id) {\n            newDifyConversationId = outputs.metadata.conversation_id;\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果还没有找到，尝试从 extractedOutput 中提取\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const DialogueContent: React.FC&lt;DialogueContentProps&gt; = \nconst handleSend = async \n\n\n    try {\n      const submission = {\n        content: draftContent || \"已上传文件\",\n        files: draftFiles,\n      };\n      lastSubmissionRef.current = submission;\n\n      // 计算新增的来源（当前选中但尚未发送过的）\n      const newSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; !sentSourceIds.includes(s.id));\n      const newSourceIds = newSources.map((s) =&gt; s.id);\n      \n      // 构建文件列表和知识库名称（仅针对新增的来源）\n      let fileList: string | undefined;\n      let knowledgeBaseNames: string | undefined;\n      \n      if (newSources.length &gt; 0) {\n        // 筛选新增的文件（type === 'external'）\n        const fileSources = newSources.filter((s) =&gt; s.type === 'external');\n        if (fileSources.length &gt; 0) {\n          fileList = fileSources.map((s) =&gt; s.title).join(', ');\n        }\n        \n        // 筛选新增的知识库（type === 'knowledge_base'）\n        const knowledgeBaseSources = newSources.filter((s) =&gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\n        if (knowledgeBaseSources.length &gt; 0) {\n          knowledgeBaseNames = knowledgeBaseSources.map((s) =&gt; s.title).join(', ');\n        }\n      }\n\n      const response = await aiSearchService.sendMessage(activeConversation.id, {\n        content: submission.content,\n        sources: newSources, // 只传递新增的来源\n        files: submission.files,\n        contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: workflowId || undefined,\n        fileList: fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (response.userMessage &amp;&amp; response.aiMessage)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 发送消息\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const { id } = req.params;\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\n        try {\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const body = {\n        content: req.body.content,\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      };\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\n        conversationId: id,\n        content: dto.content,\n        sources: dto.sources,\n        files,\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(\n        formatApiResponse(\n          true,\n          result.value,\n          result.value.error ? '发送消息成功，但工作流执行失败' : '发送消息成功'\n        )\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n        const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n  }",

        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存Dify聊天响应到数据库\n   */\n  static async saveDifyChatResponse(\n    response: DifyChatResponse,\n    userQuery: string,\n    appType: string,\n    inputs?: any\n  ): Promise&lt;{ conversation: ConversationRecord; userMessage: ChatMessageRecord; assistantMessage: ChatMessageRecord }&gt; {\n    // 1. 创建或更新对话会话\n    const conversation = await this.upsertConversation({\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      app_type: appType,\n      session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\n      status: 'active'\n    });\n\n    // 2. 保存用户消息\n    const userMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: &#96;user_${response.id}_${Date.now()}&#96;,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'user',\n      content: userQuery,\n      query: userQuery,\n      inputs: inputs ? JSON.stringify(inputs) : undefined,\n      app_type: appType,\n      status: 'completed'\n    });\n\n    // 3. 保存AI助手消息\n    const assistantMessage = await this.saveChatMessage({\n      message_id: response.id,\n      conversation_id: response.conversation_id,\n      task_id: response.task_id,\n      message_type: 'assistant',\n      content: response.answer,\n      app_type: appType,\n      dify_event: response.event,\n      dify_mode: response.mode,\n      dify_answer: response.answer,\n      prompt_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.prompt_tokens,\n      completion_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.completion_tokens,\n      total_tokens: response.metadata?.usage?.total_tokens,\n      total_price: response.metadata?.usage?.total_price,\n      currency: response.metadata?.usage?.currency,\n      latency: response.metadata?.usage?.latency,\n      retriever_resources: response.metadata?.retriever_resources ?         "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n    \n    // 只在第一次对话时，提取外部来源的文本内容（description）\n    if (isFirstMessage) {\n      const externalTextSources = effectiveSources.filter((s: any) =&gt; \n        s.type === 'external' &amp;&amp; s.description &amp;&amp; s.description.trim()\n      );\n      \n      externalTextSources.forEach((source: any) =&gt; {\n        if (source.description &amp;&amp; source.description.trim()) {\n          const title = source.title || '附加信息';\n          textContents.push(&#96;【${title}】\\n${source.description.trim()}&#96;);\n        }\n      });\n    }\n    \n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加（无论是否第一次对话）\n    if (fileMarkdownContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      textContents.push(...fileMarkdownContents);\n    }\n    \n    if (textContents.length &gt; 0) {\n      additionalContext = '\\n\\n=== 附加信息（文件内容） ===\\n' + textContents.join('\\n\\n---\\n\\n');\n      logger.info('提取附加信息（外部来源和文件markdown）', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        filesCount: fileMarkdownContents.length,\n        totalTextLength: additionalContext.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 将附加信息合并到 query 中\n    // 文件的markdown内容总是添加，外部来源的文本内容仅在第一次对话时添加\n    let finalQuery = params.content;\n    if (additionalContext) {\n      finalQuery = params.content + additionalContext;\n      logger.info('合并附加信息到查询内容', {\n        isFirstMessage,\n        originalLength: params.content.length,\n        additionalLength: additionalContext.length,\n        finalLength: finalQuery.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // 检查上一条消息是否是子Agent（工具箱）生成的内容\n    // 主Agent和子Agent交叉对话的逻辑：\n    // 1. 主对话使用同一个 dify_conversation_id 保持多轮对话\n    // 2. 子Agent（五看、三定等）处理上下文窗口内容，生成分析结果\n    // 3. 当用户继续主对话时，如果上一条是子Agent的输出，则将其作为上下文传递给主Agent\n    let toolOutputContext = '';\n    if (!isFirstMessage &amp;&amp; context.history &amp;&amp; context.history.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 找到最后一条助手消息\n      const lastAssistantMessage = [...context.history]\n        .reverse()\n        .find;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleSelectionChange = (selectedIds: string[]) =&gt; {\n    setSelectedSourceIds(selectedIds);\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateConversation = useCallback(async (): Promise&lt;Conversation | null&gt; =&gt; {\n    try {\n      clearGlobalError();\n      \n      // 如果已有当前对话，直接返回，避免重复创建\n      if (currentConversation) {\n        console.log('[ConversationDebug] 已有当前对话，跳过创建:', currentConversation.id);\n        return currentConversation;\n      }\n      \n      const selectedSources = sources.filter((s) =&gt; selectedSourceIds.includes(s.id));\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 创建新对话，来源数量:', selectedSources.length);\n\n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\n        title: &#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\//g, '/')}&#96;,\n        sources: selectedSources,\n        pageType: effectivePageType, // 使用包含项目ID的 pageType\n      });\n\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 新对话已创建:', conversation.id);\n\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\n      }\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\n      return conversation;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"创建对话失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"创建对话失败，请稍后重试\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }, [\n    clearGlobalError,\n    sources,\n    selectedSourceIds,\n    reportError,\n    selectedWorkflowId,\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\n    loadConversations,\n    currentConversation,\n    effectivePageType,\n  ]);\n\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export class ChatMessageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存聊天消息\n   */\n  static async saveChatMessage(message: ChatMessageRecord): Promise&lt;ChatMessageRecord&gt; {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO chat_messages (\n        message_id, conversation_id, task_id, message_type, content, query, inputs, app_type,\n        dify_event, dify_mode, dify_answer, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens,\n        total_price, currency, latency, retriever_resources, status, error_message\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await query(sql, [\n      message.message_id,\n      message.conversation_id,\n      message.task_id,\n      message.message_type,\n      message.content,\n      message.query,\n      message.inputs,\n      message.app_type,\n      message.dify_event,\n      message.dify_mode,\n      message.dify_answer,\n      message.prompt_tokens || 0,\n      message.completion_tokens || 0,\n      message.total_tokens || 0,\n      message.total_price,\n      message.currency || 'USD',\n      message.latency || 0,\n      message.retriever_resources,\n      message.status || 'completed',\n      message.error_message\n    ]);\n\n    return await this.getChatMessageById(message.message_id) as ChatMessageRecord;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据message_id获取聊天消息\n   */\n  static async getChatMessageById(messageId: string): Promise&lt;ChatMessageRecord | null&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    if (params.files &amp;&amp; params.files.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        // 通过文件名查找文件记录，获取markdown内容\n        for (const file of params.files) {\n          try {\n            // 通过原始文件名查找文件记录\n            const allFiles = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n              status: 'active',\n            });\n            const fileRecord = allFiles.find(\n              (f) =&gt; f.original_name === file.originalname || f.stored_name === file.filename\n            );\n            \n            if (fileRecord &amp;&amp; fileRecord.metadata) {\n              const metadata = typeof fileRecord.metadata === 'string' \n                ? JSON.parse(fileRecord.metadata) \n                : fileRecord.metadata;\n              \n              if (metadata.markdownContent) {\n                fileMarkdownContents.push(&#96;【${fileRecord.original_name}】\\n${metadata.markdownContent}&#96;);\n                logger.info('从文件记录中提取markdown内容', {\n                  fileName: fileRecord.original_name,\n                  markdownLength: metadata.markdownContent.length,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            logger.warn('提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n              fileName: file.originalname,\n              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('批量提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 判断是否是第一次对话（对话不存在或没有历史消息）\n    const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                          !params.conversation.messages || \n                          params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n    \n    // 提取附加信息：外部来源的文本内容和文件的markdown内容\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 聊天消息相关数据库表结构\n-- 用于存储AI对话和Dify返回消息\n\n-- 1. 对话会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    conversation_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的conversation_id\n    user_id TEXT, -- 用户标识\n    session_name TEXT, -- 会话名称\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型 (ai-search, tech-package等)\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 2. 聊天消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chat_messages (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    message_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Dify返回的message_id\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL, -- 关联对话会话\n    task_id TEXT, -- Dify返回的task_id\n    message_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (message_type IN ('user', 'assistant')), -- 消息类型\n    content TEXT NOT NULL, -- 消息内容\n    query TEXT, -- 用户查询内容（仅用户消息）\n    inputs TEXT, -- JSON格式存储输入参数\n    app_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- AI应用类型\n    \n    -- Dify响应相关字段\n    dify_event TEXT, -- Dify事件类型\n    dify_mode TEXT, -- Dify模式\n    dify_answer TEXT, -- Dify回答内容\n    \n    -- 使用统计\n    prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    total_price TEXT, -- 总费用\n    currency TEXT DEFAULT 'USD',\n    latency REAL DEFAULT 0, -- 响应延迟（秒）\n    \n    -- 检索资源（JSON格式）\n    retriever_resources TEXT, -- Dify检索到的资源\n    \n    -- 状态和时间\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed')),\n    error_message TEXT, -- 错误信息\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(conversation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE",

        "contents": "export class CreateConversationUseCase {\n  constructor(private readonly aiSearchService: AiSearchService) {}\n\n  async execute(dto: CreateConversationDTO): Promise&lt;Result&lt;ConversationView&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const record = await this.aiSearchService.createConversation(\n        dto.title || &#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString()}&#96;,\n        dto.sources || [],\n        dto.pageType\n      );\n\n      const conversation: ConversationView = {\n        id: record.id,\n        title: record.title,\n        sources: JSON.parse(record.sources || '[]'),\n        messages: [],\n        createdAt: new Date(record.created_at),\n        updatedAt: new Date(record.updated_at),\n      };\n\n      return success(conversation);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('创建对话失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'CREATE_CONVERSATION_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '创建对话失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      query: finalQuery,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      sources: effectiveSources,\n      files:\n        params.files?.map((f) =&gt; ({\n          name: f.originalname,\n          url: &#96;/uploads/ai-search/${f.filename}&#96;,\n          type: f.mimetype,\n        })) || [],\n      fileList: fileListArray, // 文件列表数组\n      knowledgeBaseNames: knowledgeBaseNamesArray, // 知识库名称数组\n      // 注意：使用 Dify 的 conversation_id，不是本地对话ID\n      // 首次对话时为空，Dify 会返回新的 conversation_id\n      conversationId: params.conversation?.difyConversationId || '',\n      history: context.history,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      metadata: {\n        contextGeneratedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        workflowId: params.workflowId,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n}",

existing.updatedAt.getTime() \n            : new Date(existing.updatedAt).getTime();\n          const currentTime = conv.updatedAt instanceof Date \n            ? conv.updatedAt.getTime() \n            : new Date(conv.updatedAt).getTime();\n          if (currentTime &gt; existingTime) {\n            conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\n          }\n        }\n      });\n      \n      if (duplicateIds.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.warn('[ConversationDebug] 发现重复的对话ID:', duplicateIds);\n      }\n      \n      // 转换为数组并按更新时间排序\n      const uniqueConversations = Array.from(conversationMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n        const timeA = a.updatedAt instanceof Date ? a.updatedAt.getTime() : new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime();\n        const timeB = b.updatedAt instanceof Date ? b.updatedAt.getTime() : new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime();\n        return timeB - timeA; // 降序排列，最新的在前\n      });\n      \n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 去重后的对话列表:', uniqueConversations.length, '条对话，IDs:', uniqueConversations.map(c =&gt; c.id));\n      setConversations(uniqueConversations);\n\n      if (uniqueConversations.length === 0) {\n        setCurrentConversation(null);\n        // 如果没有对话，确保加载页面类型的来源信息\n        await loadPageTypeSources();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const activeId =\n        options?.activeConversationId ||\n        currentConversation?.id ||\n        uniqueConversations[0].id;\n\n      if (!activeId) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (\n        !currentConversation ||\n        options?.refreshActive ||\n        currentConversation.id !== activeId\n      ) {\n        await loadConversationDetail(activeId);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载对话历史失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载对话历史失败，请稍后重试\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleLoadMoreMessages = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    if (\n      !currentConversation?.id ||\n      !currentConversation.nextCursor ||\n      isLoadingMoreMessages\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsLoadingMoreMessages(true);\n    try {\n      await loadConversationDetail(currentConversation.id, {\n        append: true,\n        before: currentConversation.nextCursor,\n      });\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoadingMoreMessages(false);\n    }\n  }, [currentConversation, isLoadingMoreMessages, loadConversationDetail]);",

  "contents": "  /**\n   * 获取对话详情（包含消息）\n   */\n  async getConversation(\n    id: string,\n    options?: {\n      limit?: number;\n      before?: string;\n    }\n  ): Promise&lt;any | null&gt; {\n    const conversationRows = await db.query(\n      &#96;SELECT * FROM ai_search_conversations WHERE id = ?&#96;,\n      [id]\n    ) as any[];\n\n    if (conversationRows.length === 0) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const conversation = conversationRows[0];\n\n    const limit = options?.limit &amp;&amp; Number.isFinite(options.limit)\n      ? Math.min(Math.max(Number(options.limit), 1), 200)\n      : undefined;\n    const before = options?.before;\n\n    const params: any[] = [id];\n    let query = &#96;\n      SELECT * FROM ai_search_messages \n      WHERE conversation_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n\n    if (before) {\n      query += &#96; AND created_at &lt; ?&#96;;\n      params.push(before);\n    }\n\n    query += &#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&#96;;\n\n    if (limit) {\n      query += &#96; LIMIT ?&#96;;\n      params.push(limit + 1);\n    }\n\n    const messageRows = await db.query(query, params) as any[];\n\n    let hasMore = false;\n    let nextCursor: string | null = null;\n\n    if (limit &amp;&amp; messageRows.length &gt; limit) {\n      hasMore = true;\n      const lastRow = messageRows[messageRows.length - 1];\n      nextCursor = lastRow.created_at;\n      messageRows.pop();\n    } else if (limit &amp;&amp; messageRows.length === limit) {\n      const oldestRow = messageRows[messageRows.length - 1];\n      const countRows = await db.query(\n        &#96;SELECT COUNT(1) as total FROM ai_search_messages WHERE conversation_id = ? AND created_at &lt; ?&#96;,\n        [id, oldestRow.created_at]\n      ) as any[];\n      const remaining = countRows?.[0]?.total || 0;\n      hasMore = remaining &gt; 0;\n      nextCursor = hasMore ? oldestRow.created_at : null;\n    }\n\n    const messagesAsc = [...messageRows].reverse();\n\n    return {\n      id: conversation.id,\n      title: conversation.title,\n      sources: JSON.parse(conversation.sources || '[]'),\n      difyConversationId: conversation.dify_conversation_id,\n      messages: messagesAsc.map((row) =&gt; ({\n        id: row.id,\n        role: row.role,\n        content: row.content,\n        sources: row.sources ? JSON.parse(row.sources) : [],\n        outputs: row.outputs ? JSON.parse(row.outputs) : {},\n        createdAt: new Date(row.created_at),\n      })),",
